name: Rust Analyzer Context Indexing
purpose: Build and query code-context indexes for Rust workspaces through rust-analyzer: Cargo metadata crate-graph loading, LSP symbol/hover/definition/reference extraction, flycheck-gated freshness, and ranked bounded query answers.
inputs: Workspace root with cargo metadata output and rust-analyzer version
Sysroot source for std symbols and flycheck command for diagnostics
Token budget caps for query answers (max symbols and max tokens)
Golden symbol set covering generics, trait objects, async fns, and macros
outputs: Loaded rust-analyzer workspace with crate graph report
Queryable symbol, reference, trait-implementation, and hover-signature index
Freshness report with stale flags plus golden recall and latency report
stop_conditions: Golden symbol recall reaches 100% with query p95 under 300 ms on a warm workspace
Single-file save propagates to fresh query results in under 4 seconds
